key_people.name: 阿扎马特·阿布杜卡里莫维奇·萨基耶夫（Азамат Абдукаримович Сакиев）
key_people.title: 总经理（Генеральный директор）
key_people.title_description: General Director / CEO of the State Enterprise National Company Kyrgyz Temir Jolu
key_people.description: Born 20 February 1989. Appointed 28 June 2021 by Cabinet Chairman Ulukbek Maripov on nomination of the State Property Management Fund. Holds higher education in management (Nottingham University UK, International Business; Malaysia). Joined Kyrgyz Temir Jolu in 2019 as head of state procurement department under the Material-Technical Supply branch. Led record 2025 freight volumes (>10 Mt) and oversees strategic projects: China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway construction, Balykchy-Kochkor line, and digitalization of cargo logistics.

recent_events.title: 中吉乌铁路项目正式启动建设
recent_events.description: Ceremony in Jalal-Abad attended by representatives of China, Kyrgyzstan and Uzbekistan marking the official start of construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway, a 25-year-discussed megaproject. Project ownership: 51% China, 24.5% Kyrgyzstan (KTJ), 24.5% Uzbekistan. Kyrgyzstan segment ~270 km, estimated cost ~USD 4.5 billion.
recent_events.impact: Transformative: connects Kyrgyzstan to China's standard-gauge network and creates a new Eurasian transit corridor. Largest infrastructure project in modern Kyrgyz history.

recent_events.title: 中吉乌铁路吉尔吉斯斯坦段关键设施开工
recent_events.description: Ceremony in Suzak district of Jalal-Abad region marking start of construction of key China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway facilities. By end of 2025: 192.3 km of temporary access roads built, 11 main construction camps commissioned, all 29 tunnels moved into underground excavation phase, temporary power line fully energized.
recent_events.impact: Construction moved from symbolic groundbreaking to active execution phase

recent_events.title: 吉尔吉斯斯坦主持SCO铁路管理部门第六次会议
recent_events.description: Bishkek hosted the 6th Meeting of Heads of Railway Administrations of SCO member states, chaired by Kyrgyz Temir Jolu. Attendees from Belarus, India, Iran, Pakistan, Kazakhstan, China, Russia, Tajikistan and Uzbekistan. GM Sakiev reported 33% growth in cargo volumes with SCO countries over past two years.
recent_events.impact: Strengthened Kyrgyzstan's leadership role in Eurasian rail diplomacy

recent_events.title: 员工住宅综合体奠基（首创独立后历史）
recent_events.description: First stone laid for residential complex for railway workers - first such project in independent Kyrgyzstan's railway sector. Agreement between KTJ, State Mortgage Company, and Affairs Administration of the Cabinet of Ministers. 285 apartments planned; by late 2025 construction reached 14th floor in three blocks.
recent_events.impact: Major social benefit upgrade for 5,866 employees

recent_events.title: 中吉乌铁路项目签署银团贷款协议
recent_events.description: Credit agreement signed in Bishkek between LLC Railway Company China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan and a syndicate of Chinese banks (Export-Import Bank of China and China Development Bank) to finance CKU railway construction.
recent_events.impact: Secured financing for the largest BRI railway project in Central Asia

recent_events.title: 2025年货运量创历史新高（突破1000万吨）
recent_events.description: End-of-year summary: 2025 cargo volume exceeded 10 million tons - a record high in the history of Kyrgyz railway. Up from 9.2 million tons in 2024 and the long-term average of ~7 million tons. Equity grew from 7.5 bn KGS to 42.7 bn KGS during 2023-2025 strategic plan; total assets reached 45.3 bn KGS. Paid 800+ Mio KGS in taxes and 700+ Mio KGS to Social Fund. Named Best State Enterprise twice by State Property Agency.
recent_events.impact: Demonstrates successful turnaround strategy initiated in 2021 - financial sustainability restored after years of losses

recent_events.title: 巴雷克奇-汤奇-乔尔蓬阿塔铁路奠基
recent_events.description: President Sadyr Japarov attended the groundbreaking for the Balykchy-Tamchy-Cholpon-Ata railway on Issyk-Kul, a ~86 km touristic and strategic line.
recent_events.impact: New tourism infrastructure on Issyk-Kul; strategic North-South connectivity

core_business: National railway operator of Kyrgyzstan. Operates a 424.6 km broad-gauge (1,520 mm) network divided into a 323.4 km northern section (Lugovaya-Balykchy, connecting to Kazakhstan and Russia via Turkestan-Siberia railway) and a 101.2 km southern section (four spurs at Osh, Jalal-Abad, Kyzyl-Kiya and Tash-Komur, connecting to Uzbekistan). 28 stations. Freight services (cargo: coal, oil, construction materials, grain, machinery) are profitable; passenger services (regulated fares) carry ~420,000 passengers/year on routes like Bishkek-Balykchy, Bishkek-Tokmok, Bishkek-Kazan, Bishkek-Moscow. Strategic priority is construction of the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway and domestic North-South line Balykchy-Kochkor-Kara-Kèche. The company also owns Bishkek-2 station headquarters, sports complex Lokomotiv, and an in-house Locorobot (autonomous shunting locomotive) production project.
apec_stance: Kyrgyz Temir Jolu is not a direct APEC stakeholder since Kyrgyzstan is not an APEC member, but the company is the central node in China's Belt and Road Initiative (BRI) in Central Asia. Its flagship project, the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan (CKU) railway, broke ground on 27 December 2024 in Jalal-Abad and is the largest cross-border BRI railway project in the region, with 51% Chinese ownership (China State Railway Group), 24.5% Kyrgyz (KTJ), 24.5% Uzbek. The Kyrgyz section (~270 km, 29 tunnels) costs an estimated USD 4.5 billion financed by a Chinese banking syndicate (EximBank of China + China Development Bank, agreement signed 16 December 2025). The company also participates in EAEU railway integration (1,520 mm gauge) through the CIS Railway Council and is deepening cooperation with Iran, Pakistan (NLC), and the Organization of Turkic States on the Trans-Caspian International Transport Route. KTJ's strategic plan 2023-2025 delivered record financial results - equity grew from 7.5 bn to 42.7 bn KGS, cargo volume exceeded 10 million tons in 2025.

General Director Azamat Sakiev (Азамат Сакиев, b. 20 Feb 1989) appointed 28 June 2021, age 32. Network: 424.6 km broad-gauge 1520mm; 28 stations; 5,866 staff. Record 2025: >10 Mt cargo (up from 9.2 Mt in 2024 and 7 Mt historical average). Equity grew 7.5bn -> 42.7bn KGS during Strategic Plan 2023-2025.
